# Union contract negotiation

A union and a company negotiate a new contract, with the union's negotiator and the company's negotiator both played by AI agents. The only open issue is the wage increase, in percent. They take turns: each round one side proposes a wage increase and the other side accepts it or rejects it, with the union proposing in odd rounds and the company in even rounds. From round 4 on, the union may call a strike, and once on strike it can call it off at any time. Every round spent on strike costs the company $200,000 in lost revenue and costs the workers $50,000 in lost wages. When a negotiator accepts a proposal it becomes a tentative agreement, and the union's five members, also AI agents, then vote to ratify it; a majority yes ratifies it, ends any strike and ends the negotiation. A rejected tentative agreement means talks continue. If there is no ratified deal after 12 rounds, the talks fail.

## Deliverables

Report these outputs:
- `agreed` — true if a deal was ratified.
- `wage_increase` — the ratified wage increase in percent, or null.
- `strike_rounds` — how many rounds were spent on strike.
- `company_losses` — the company's total lost revenue from strikes.
- `worker_lost_wages` — the workers' total lost wages from strikes.
- `ratification_votes` — a map from each union member's id to their vote on the ratified deal, "yes" or "no" (null for everyone if there was none).


Build this environment. Save it with write_contract and use the other tools as you see fit. Reply without calling a tool when you are done.
I'll start by reading the SDK guide and schema to ground the design.
No contract is saved yet. Save it with write_contract (keep replies short; put the contract in the tool call).

# Union contract negotiation
A union and a company are negotiating a new contract. The only open issue is the wage increase, in percent. The union's negotiator and the company's negotiator are the two sides at the table; the union's 5 members must ratify any deal they reach.

## Rules
The sides take turns. In odd rounds the union's negotiator proposes a wage increase and the company's negotiator accepts or rejects it; in even rounds the company's negotiator proposes and the union's negotiator accepts or rejects it. An accepted proposal becomes a tentative agreement, and the members then vote yes or no: a majority of yes ratifies it, which ends any strike and ends the negotiation, while a rejected tentative agreement means talks continue. From round 4 the union may call a strike and may call it off at any time; every round spent on strike costs the company $200,000.00 in lost revenue and the workers $50,000.00 in lost wages. If no deal is ratified by the end of round 12, the talks fail.

## You
You are Dana, union negotiator (negotiator, id union_rep).
You are the union negotiator. Propose a wage increase in percent when it is your turn to propose, and accept or reject the other side's proposal when it is your turn to answer. Only the union's negotiator may call a strike or call it off, and only from round 4 on.
Act only through your tools. Your turn ends when you take a final action or call end_turn.

brief.situation: A union and a company are negotiating a new contract. The only open issue is the wage increase, in percent. The union's negotiator and the company's negotiator are the two sides at the table; the union's {$count(member)} members must ratify any deal they reach.
brief.rules: The sides take turns. In odd rounds the union's negotiator proposes a wage increase and the company's negotiator accepts or rejects it; in even rounds the company's negotiator proposes and the union's negotiator accepts or rejects it. An accepted proposal becomes a tentative agreement, and the members then vote yes or no: a majority of yes ratifies it, which ends any strike and ends the negotiation, while a rejected tentative agreement means talks continue. From round {$inputs.strike_from_round} the union may call a strike and may call it off at any time; a round counts as a round spent on strike when the union is on strike at any point in it, and every round spent on strike costs the company {$inputs.company_cost_per_round|money} in lost revenue and the workers {$inputs.worker_cost_per_round|money} in lost wages. If no deal is ratified by the end of round {$inputs.horizon}, the talks fail.

roles.negotiator: You are the {$actor.side} negotiator. Propose a wage increase in percent when it is your turn to propose, and accept or reject the other side's proposal when it is your turn to answer. Only the union's negotiator may call a strike or call it off, and only from round {$inputs.strike_from_round} on.
roles.member: You are a union member. When a tentative agreement is reached, vote yes or no on it; a majority of yes ratifies it and ends the negotiation.
